name: Molecule placement
description: Molecules at true scale on the lattice result, exported exactly like Export… (SVG by default).

lattice_result_json.label: Lattice result (blank = latest)
lattice_result_json.description: Optional. Run Lattice measurements first; leave blank to use latest result for open scan.

molecule_image.label: Molecule artwork
molecule_image.description: Use the large Load molecule SVG / PNG… button above the parameters; the selected file appears there with a thumbnail.

molecule_width_nm.label: Width (nm)
molecule_width_nm.description: Real-space width of the drawn molecule itself (empty artwork margins are trimmed automatically). 0 = derive from height and artwork aspect.

molecule_height_nm.label: Height (nm)
molecule_height_nm.description: Real-space height of the drawn molecule itself. 0 = derive from width and artwork aspect (recommended to avoid stretching).

trim_artwork_margins.label: Trim empty artwork margins
trim_artwork_margins.description: Recommended. Uses the bounding box of the non-transparent / non-white pixels of the artwork, so transparent or white borders no longer shrink the molecules.

orientation_mode.label: Alignment
orientation_mode.description: Auto: align image height/width axis to computed primitive lattice a vector. Manual: use angle below.

molecule_count.label: Count (0 = all sites)
molecule_count.description: 0 places a molecule on every eligible lattice site. N>0 places exactly up to N molecules, nearest the chosen origin first.

export_gwy.label: Also save Gwyddion .gwy
export_gwy.description: Off: only the publication figure is saved (format set in Options › Results).
